events.summary: Set rbac.create=false and clusterAdministrator=false in both GitOps and direct Helm values. Added an explicitly enumerated velero-server ClusterRole and binding for platform backup/restore resources, PV/PVC, snapshots, namespaces, CRD discovery/creation, and velero.io resources. The provisioning script applies the shared RBAC manifest before Helm installation. Added an owning Argo CD Application at wave 0 and placed Velero at wave 1. Added R204-R206 and a lessons-log row.

Lead live-ran the RBAC on the six-node kubeadm cluster. The old ClusterRoleBinding named velero-server collided with the chart binding and failed immutable roleRef validation. The first backup was forbidden from listing clusterrolebindings. After adding cluster RBAC read live, a namespace backup with only cm/secret/sa/role/rolebinding saved 10/10 selected items but ended PartiallyFailed with 96 errors across 48 discovered namespaced kinds because Velero LISTs every discovered kind in each included namespace.
evidence: live:clusterrolebinding velero-server immutable roleRef cluster-admin apply failure
live:namespace backup PartiallyFailed; 10/10 items, 96 forbidden errors, 48 kinds

events.summary: Renamed the managed binding, documented chart rbac.create=false rendering no ClusterRoleBinding and Argo prune removal of the old chart binding, and made 08-4-storage.sh delete velero-server only when roleRef is cluster-admin. Generated read rules from the captured live discovery snapshot for every listable kind except documented sensitive/ephemeral exclusions, including cluster RBAC read. Kept all RBAC writes excluded to prevent restoring broader Roles/RoleBindings, retained Secret read, and limited write rules to namespaced resources plus PVs/namespaces and create-only CRDs; velero.io keeps full access.

R204-R207 passed, including mutation verification for discovery drift, forbidden privilege mutations, and the legacy binding upgrade guard. Full static Kakao suite passed with 247 passes, 0 failures, and 4 existing environment warnings.
